transmission.boundary: Only each grid's non-negative increment above the lowest observed grid charge is added to node T&D, because the inherited T&D capital representation already carries the common network cost. The lowest published PDS component is used as a conservative inter-island wheeling proxy; it is not claimed to be a project-specific LV or VM tariff.

renewables.cost_mapping: The official Philippine 2024 capital and fixed-O&M anchors replace each technology's 2024 national anchor; inherited year-to-2024 cost ratios preserve the existing learning trajectory. The anchor is common across nodes because DOE reports a common plant cost. Geographic differentiation comes from resource CF, finite potential and grid delivery charges, not an invented plant-cost wedge.

structural_cleanup.reason: All six have zero residual capacity and zero total/new-capacity reachability in every retained scenario. This implements the existing sourced Luzon-only grid-gas boundary; it is not inferred from zero BASE activity.
